source_citation: K. Choudhary et al., Computational screening of high-performance optoelectronic materials using OptB88vdW and TB-mBJ formalisms, Scientific Data 5, 180082 (2018), Table 3, DOI 10.1038/sdata.2018.82
retrieval_method: Pinned transcription of documentation lines 441-499, reduced to identifiers, OPT gap, experimental gap, and source fields used by the demonstrator
retrieval_timestamp_utc: unknown: the verification date 2026-07-11 was retained without a clock time
selection_rule: Retain every row in the cited table for which both OPT and experimental gaps are finite and strictly positive; no residual-based filtering, imputation, or model fit enters selection
deduplication_rule: jvasp_id must be unique; repeated chemical formulas are retained as distinct structures
known_source_dependence: Repeated formulas and unresolved shared experimental sources may be correlated; the worked demonstrator does not treat this table as independent population evidence
license_status: Adapted from Table 3 of the cited Scientific Data article under CC BY 4.0
rights_basis: CC BY 4.0 covers the cited table; attribution, licence link, transformation notice, third-party-material qualification, and non-endorsement boundary are retained
redistribution_decision: Bundled as an attributed CC BY 4.0 adaptation with the source DOI, transformation description, qualification, and licence notice retained
active_filter: finite positive bandgap_opt_ev and bandgap_expt_ev only
measurement_type_status: The source labels the dependent column experimental but does not resolve fundamental versus optical measurement type row by row
constraint: e_i=E_i/E0; c_i(gamma,e_i)=log(e_i/(gamma E_i^OPT/E0))=0 with E0=1 eV
likelihood: Fixed outcome-independent Gaussian likelihood in energy: sigma=sqrt((0.15 E_OPT)^2+(0.12 eV)^2)
correction_measure_contract: graph multiplier is J/q; here J=1/e and q=1
determinant_route: exact diagonal log-energy-residual state Jacobian 1/e, checked with detcorr
anti_circular_validation: Global Gauss-Hermite quadrature is performed over every positive dimensionless energy state
The corrected finite tube includes the state-dependent 1/e multiplier inside a separate integral
MCMC and SMC sample graph and naive targets only; no duplicate corrected branch is claimed as independent validation
rejected_construction: u=E0/E with c=1/u-gamma*x under Lebesgue du has a divergent finite-rho state integral; a formal hard-limit calculation does not repair it
target_measure: graph posterior over gamma with respect to d gamma
